lines.zh: 我的脚步声很重，地板在响。
lines.en: My steps fall heavy and the floor boards answer.

lines.zh: 关节里全是弹簧，走起来吱吱的。
lines.en: Springs fill my joints and squeal as I walk.
I walk the corridor one step at a time.
This suit does not allow speed.

lines.zh: 我朝着有动静的地方走。
lines.en: I walk toward whatever moved.
My steps stop and the lamp comes on.
I do not hide, and I need not.

lines.zh: 我的机械关节咔哒一声。
lines.en: My mechanical joint clicks once.
Around the corner, my eyes lift.
My fingers drag along the floor.
I keep my steps very steady.

lines.zh: 这身紫皮，从走廊这头到那头。
lines.en: This purple suit, from one end of the hall to the other.

lines.zh: 我站着，听房间里的声音。
lines.en: I stand and listen to the room.
The springs are wound tight under my suit.
Mice are running inside the wall.

lines.zh: 我的脸一直笑着，收不回来。
lines.en: My face is stuck smiling.

lines.zh: 灯照着我，我不觉得刺眼。
lines.en: The lamp is on me. It does not bother me.
One of my ears droops sideways.

lines.zh: 这地方的味道，是霉和铁。
lines.en: This place smells of mildew and iron.
I wait for something to move first.
There is a wire above my head.

lines.zh: 后台的幕布被风吹起来。
lines.en: The backstage curtain lifts in the draft.
You are not on my list.
You are not what I am after.

lines.zh: 我只杀怪物，你别站中间。
lines.en: I hunt monsters only; don't stand between.
I do not want to hurt you. Move aside.

lines.zh: 我的眼窝是空的，可我看得见。
lines.en: My eye sockets are empty, yet I see.
I cannot tell what you are.
Something else is moving in here.

lines.zh: 我手上有别的东西的味道。
lines.en: There is another smell on my hands.
Stay if you are staying.
I am only looking for those things.
My suit has been torn open.

lines.zh: 这一下打中了我里面的架子。
lines.en: That struck the frame inside me.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，弹簧还紧着。
lines.en: I take half a step back and the springs hold.
Half my face came off.
One eye's light has gone out.

lines.zh: 弹簧外皮破了，棉花露出来。
lines.en: My spring-suit skin tears, stuffing showing.

lines.zh: 我的关节在响，但还能动。
lines.en: My joints rattle, but they still move.

lines.zh: 我把它记在心里，如果我有心。
lines.en: I will remember it, if I have a memory.
That knocked me crooked.
I steady and bring my hand back.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，这嘴里塞满了铁。
lines.en: I do not eat. My mouth is packed with metal.

lines.zh: 那味道让我想起旧日子。
lines.en: That smell takes me back.
Leave it there. I cannot take it.

lines.zh: 我把鼻子凑过去闻了闻。
lines.en: I lean my snout over and sniff.

lines.zh: 这味道和地下室的不一样。
lines.en: This does not smell like the basement.
You eat. I will stand here.

lines.zh: 我的嘴合不上，别塞进来。
lines.en: My mouth will not close. Do not put that in.
Food will draw the other things.

lines.zh: 我盯着那个盘子看了很久。
lines.en: I stared at that plate a long while.
Do not save me any. I have no use for it.
Your shove does not move me.
I stand firmer than I look.
Do not touch me from behind.
You hit metal, not cloth.

lines.zh: 金属壳撞上来，只留下一道白痕。
lines.en: Metal knocks against me, leaving only a pale mark.
Go around. I am passing through.
Did that hurt your hand?
I do not dodge. The springs will not allow it.
You knocked my joints into rattling.
Make way. We are not enemies.
I am only a spare suit.
The one on stage is the real one.
We wear the same skin.
When it does not move, I do.

lines.zh: 我不和谁配对，也不需要。
lines.en: I pair with no one and need to.

lines.zh: 这间屋里有几个像我一样的。
lines.en: There are a few like me in this building.
We do not speak to each other.
When one breaks, the next takes over.

lines.zh: 我记着另一个的脚步声。
lines.en: I remember another one's footsteps.
It is not here anymore.

lines.zh: 地上有根铁丝，我踩住了。
lines.en: A wire on the floor. I step on it.

lines.zh: 我捡起一只掉落的玩偶手臂。
lines.en: I pick up a fallen animatronic arm.
This is too small for my hands.

lines.zh: 我的手指夹起了一块布。
lines.en: My fingers pinch up a scrap of cloth.
My springs have rusted shut.
It rolled into the corner.

lines.zh: 我把挡路的东西踢到一边。
lines.en: I kick the obstruction aside.
My handprint is left on the floor.
I press it and it crumbles.
I need none of these.
Something is crawling inside the wall.

lines.zh: 那边有个影子动了一下。
lines.en: A shadow moved over there.
Not a person, but it still needs dealing with.

lines.zh: 关节响了一声，我锁定了它。
lines.en: A joint clicks; I've locked on.

lines.zh: 我有二十年没这么兴奋了。
lines.en: I have not felt this way in twenty years.
That smell is rotten.
It is hiding behind the cabinet.
I heard it. Stop pretending.
This building is mine to keep.

lines.zh: 舞台上的灯照出它的影子。
lines.en: The stage lights cast its shadow.
Its claws scrape the floor.

lines.zh: 目标锁定，我认得它的形状。
lines.en: Target fixed. I know that shape.
My ear turns toward it first.
Nobody will come to help it.
I raise a hand and the air moves.
This time I will not let it go.
It runs along the base of the wall.

lines.zh: 我的脚步比它重，但不会慢。
lines.en: My steps are heavier, not slower.
It turns into the corridor and I follow.

lines.zh: 我看到它爪子上的东西了。
lines.en: I have seen what is on its claws.
It is aiming for the window.
I stand in front of the window.
It doubles back and I follow again.
This room has only one door.

lines.zh: 它的脚步声在瓷砖上乱响。
lines.en: Its footsteps clatter wildly on the tiles.

lines.zh: 弹簧在我身上越来越紧。
lines.en: The springs wind tighter in me.

lines.zh: 我不需要追快，只要不停。
lines.en: I need not be fast, only unceasing.
It has hidden behind the stage.
I push the stage aside.
Its eyes shine in the dark.
My eyes hold those two points of light.
The floor creaks under my steps.
It backs into the corner. No room left.

lines.zh: 我把手抬到胸口的高度。
lines.en: I raise my hand to chest height.
It lunges.
I do not dodge, and I do not yield.
My hand clamps around its neck.

lines.zh: 这一拳把墙打出一个坑。
lines.en: My punch leaves a dent in the wall.
It bites me and cannot get through.
I hurl it against the floor.

lines.zh: 弹簧弹开，我的手臂撑直了。
lines.en: The spring snaps and my arm locks out.
I pin its leg under a foot.

lines.zh: 它抓我的脸，只抓下一块漆。
lines.en: It rakes my face and only takes paint.
I press down and the floor cracks.

lines.zh: 我的手指抠进它的皮里。
lines.en: My fingers dig into its hide.

lines.zh: 我的机械手掐住它的脖子。
lines.en: My mechanical hand clamps its throat.
Its bones made a sound at that.
I have both its hands.
I drive its head toward the floor.

lines.zh: 它挣开了一下，我又抓住。
lines.en: It broke free once and I took hold again.

lines.zh: 我整个身体的重量压上去。
lines.en: The whole weight of this body comes down.

lines.zh: 它还在动，不过越来越慢。
lines.en: It still moves, slower and slower.
I straighten and kick it away.
There is blood on this floor now.
The springs have gone quiet.
I look down to be sure it has stopped.

lines.zh: 我从储藏室的门后走出来。
lines.en: I come out from behind the storeroom door.
Someone wound my springs tight.

lines.zh: 这一身皮，被重新缝好了。
lines.en: This suit has been stitched again.
The lights came up and I raised my head.
I stand at the start of the corridor.
There is a layer of metal filings underfoot.
My fingers opened by themselves.
The building is darker than I remember.
I smile. The paint is smiling.
I hear something upstairs.

lines.zh: 我抬脚，第一块地板响了。
lines.en: I lift a foot and the first board groans.

lines.zh: 这身紫皮，今晚派上用场。
lines.en: This purple suit earns its keep tonight.
The fur caught and the smell is awful.

lines.zh: 我从楼梯上滚下去，摔得很沉。
lines.en: I rolled down the stairs and landed heavy.

lines.zh: 水灌进壳里，我的关节卡了。
lines.en: Water fills the shell and my joints jam.

lines.zh: 爆响把我掀翻，弹簧全响。
lines.en: The blast flipped me and every spring rang.

lines.zh: 我的耳朵里，塞着一支箭。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my ear.

lines.zh: 怪力推着我自己动起来。
lines.en: Odd force pushed me into moving on its own.

lines.zh: 我不吃东西，可架子会锈。
lines.en: I do not eat, but the frame rusts.

lines.zh: 雷打下来，我的灯闪了一下。
lines.en: Lightning struck and my eye light flickered.
The floor gave way and I dropped into dark.
